name: User Service: Get Current Delivery Address

value.data: def base = (_enum_store?.clients?.get('user_svc.ch.host') ?: '').toString(); def customerId = _global?.customer?.customerId?.toString(); def addressId = _global?.oxford_unit_details?.deliveryAddressId?.toString(); return base + '/userservice/v5/users/' + customerId + '/contacts/' + addressId

def headers = [:]; headers['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'; headers['X-PERF-TEST'] = (_global?.threadContext?.perfFlag ?: 'false').toString(); headers['Authorization'] = 'Bearer ' + (_global?.nodeParameters?.userSvcAuthToken ?: '').toString(); return headers
